worldcombat.skill.flamecharge.summary: Charges in a straight line cloaked in flame: the first target actually hurt takes the full hit and is knocked aside, then the user's Speed rises; with pierce it ploughs on, each later foe along the line taking a lighter hit.
worldcombat.skill.flamecharge.use.0: Charge straight into a lone target
worldcombat.skill.flamecharge.use.1: Set a whole line of clustered foes alight
worldcombat.skill.flamecharge.use.2: Boost Speed, then run the new speed down
worldcombat.skill.flamecharge.descriptio: The charge deals about %1$s damage, rushing %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks/tick; when the user is soaked the hit is ×0.85.

With pierce the first target actually hurt takes full damage and each later foe struck along the line takes %1$s of it; a landed hit raises the user's Speed by %2$s stage(s) (at most once per cast, fading once combat ends) and knocks the struck target about %3$s blocks along the charge. Contacts that are immune or blocked neither carry nor boost. The charge's lateral hit radius is about %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.flamecharge.pierce.on: Pierce: charge through the first target and set the rest of the line alight (later targets take the pierce share); each hit is lighter and the cooldown longer.
worldcombat.skill.flamecharge.pierce.off: Focused: stop on the first target, heavier and quicker to recover.
worldcombat.skill.flamecharge.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.flamecharge.preference: On: charge through the first target and scorch the line behind it (later targets take only the pierce share), at the cost of a lighter single hit and a longer cooldown. Off: stop on the first target, heavier and quicker.
Only charge when the foe is within this range; smaller stays on top of it, larger takes a longer run-up.
On: with pierce on, prefer charging when others line up behind the target. Off: only the threat itself matters.
worldcombat.skill.flamecharge.descriptio: The charge runs in a straight line and stops on an obstacle or when the distance is spent; reaching no one wastes the cast.
